items.positioning: Decagon can differentiate on native multilingual support baked into agent reasoning (not just translation overlay), lower latency for voice interactions, and superior handling of code-switching and regional accents—particularly in markets where real-time translation degrades quality.

items.title: Cresta Expands Global Reach with Real-Time Voice Translation and Multilingual AI Across the Platform
items.summary: Cresta launched real-time voice translation and multilingual AI capabilities across its platform to expand global customer support coverage. The feature enables agents to handle multilingual interactions with real-time translation and language-aware insights.
items.positioning: Decagon can differentiate by emphasizing native multilingual voice reasoning (not translation-layer dependence) and tighter integration with actual agent workflows; translation-first approaches often introduce latency and context loss that hurt real-time voice quality.

items.title: Cresta Insights Report: Reducing Ramp Time & Agent Attrition
items.summary: Cresta published an insights report on AI-driven real-time coaching reducing agent ramp time and attrition while improving productivity and customer experience. This is a competitive positioning document showcasing Cresta's value proposition in the contact-center AI space.
items.positioning: Decagon could position voice and chat agents as complementary or superior to real-time coaching alone: agents handle routine inquiries end-to-end (reducing agent workload and burnout), while coaching focuses on human escalations and complex cases. Alternatively, emphasize that Decagon's agents reduce the need for large agent pools, directly addressing the root cause of attrition—understaffing and repetitive work.

items.title: Cresta Insights Report: Reducing Ramp Time & Agent Attrition
items.summary: Cresta released an Insights Report on using AI-driven real-time coaching to reduce agent ramp time and attrition while improving productivity and customer experience. This is a competitive positioning report from a direct rival in the enterprise customer-support AI space.
items.positioning: Decagon can differentiate by emphasizing its focus on autonomous agent deflection and resolution—reducing the volume agents must handle—versus Cresta's coaching-augmentation model. Position Decagon as shifting the economics from training existing agents to replacing repetitive work entirely.

items.title: Cresta Is Now on Google Cloud Marketplace – Making AI for Contact Centers Easier Than Ever
items.summary: Cresta announced availability on Google Cloud Marketplace, enabling easier deployment of its AI contact-center platform on GCP. This expands Cresta's distribution and removes friction for enterprise buyers already on Google Cloud infrastructure.
items.positioning: Decagon can emphasize native flexibility across cloud providers, faster time-to-value for customers not locked into GCP, and differentiation in voice-agent capabilities vs. Cresta's primary focus on conversation analytics and coaching.
